categories-desc: In-app puts it in your inbox. Push sends it to the devices where you turned on push notifications.
email-announcements-desc: Important news about RMH Studios, a few times a year.
email-desc: Choose which emails we send you. Required notices about your account or the service are always sent.
email-digest-desc: A weekly summary of activity you missed.
email-note: Email off by default for this category.
email-security-desc: Sign-ins from a new device and changes to how you sign in. We recommend leaving this on.
quiet-desc: Push notifications are held during these hours.
tab-badge-desc: Shows the number of unread messages and notifications in the tab title and icon on this device.
